title: Implement UID references in VariantParser
body:
Addresses part of #99910

Incorporates #101720 from @KoBeWi 

Implement uid Resource references in VariantWriter

Currently, ConfigFile, often used for .import or project settings, supports Resource() references, but only supports one string argument, either path or uid.

This changes VariantWriter to write the uid by default, rather than the path.

This PR changes a few things.
1. Changes VariantWriter to serialize uid:// and the res:// path in Resource().
2. Changes VariantParser to support additional string arguments to Resource(), such as uid.
3. Fixes null crash in ResourceLoader if a uid:// path is passed in which doesn't exist or resolves to empty string.

With this PR (not compatible with 4.4):
```
...
import_script/path=""
_subresources={
"nodes": {
"PATH:root/Skeleton3D": {
"rest_pose/external_animation_library": Resource("uid://bq37qlo34ksmr", "res://Fox_anim_library.glb"),
"rest_pose/load_pose": 2,
"rest_pose/selected_animation": "Survey",
"retarget/bone_map": Resource("uid://escdjch3s7e7", "res://fox_bone_map.tres")
}
}
}
gltf/naming_version=0
gltf/embedded_image_handling=1
```

Example .import file in Godot 4.4 or below, for comparison:
```
...
import_script/path=""
_subresources={
"nodes": {
"PATH:root/Skeleton3D": {
"rest_pose/external_animation_library": Resource("res://Fox_anim_library.glb"),
"rest_pose/load_pose": 2,
"rest_pose/selected_animation": "Survey",
"retarget/bone_map": Resource("res://fox_bone_map.tres")
}
}
}
gltf/naming_version=0
gltf/embedded_image_handling=1
```

<details>
<summary>Previous version of the PR</summary>

Included 7 changes:
1. Changes VariantWriter to serialize uid instead of res path. This does not break compatibility since 4.3 and 4.4 (and possibly earlier versions) support loading uid:// paths in ResourceLoader.
2. Changes VariantParser to support additional string arguments to Resource(), such as uid.
3. VariantWriter stores both the uid and path, but for now only when `DISABLE_DEPRECATED`.
4. For serialization, ConfigFile uses a VariantWriter encode_resource_func, which generates the uid-to-path mapping as the variant is serialized.
5. To augment the existing ConfigFile format while maintaining compatibility, ConfigFile stores the mapping from uid-to-path on lines starting with  =, which were ignored.
6. Changes two places in EditorFileSystem to use ConfigFIle for .import files, instead of string writing. Due to ConfigFile being ordered (due to using HashMap), whatever concern originally existed about ensuring [remap] be first, is still fulfilled using ConfigFile.
7 Fixes null crash in ResourceLoader if a uid:// path is passed in which doesn't exist or resolves to empty string.

Config file serialization from this PR, without `DISABLE_DEPRECATED`:
```
[params]

nodes/root_type=""
...
import_script/path=""
={
"uid://bq37qlo34ksmr": "res://Fox_anim_library.glb",
"uid://escdjch3s7e7": "res://fox_bone_map.tres"
}
_subresources={
"nodes": {
"PATH:root/Skeleton3D": {
"rest_pose/external_animation_library": Resource("uid://bq37qlo34ksmr"),
"rest_pose/load_pose": 2,
"rest_pose/selected_animation": "Survey",
"retarget/bone_map": Resource("uid://escdjch3s7e7")
}
}
}
gltf/naming_version=0
gltf/embedded_image_handling=1
```
</details>
